independent_verification.recovered_law: In Text A the speaker is the passive recipient of destructive forces (Eros, love, pain acting upon them), whereas in Text B the speaker is the active agent of destruction and harm directed outward toward others.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural shift: from the self as passive recipient of external destructive forces to the self as the active origin/agent of destruction radiating outward toward others.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final lines maintain the reversal: 'your pain / shines back at me' (received) becomes 'my harm / stares out from me' (projected), preserving the changed agency.
